mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE status = 1 AND start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() AND (total_count = 0 OR used_count < total_count) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (name, type, threshold, discount, total_count, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{threshold}, #{discount}, #{totalCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
